name: B10-0145/2025 (PfE) – White paper on the future of European defence
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text:
The European Parliament is giving its opinion on a planned European Commission white paper on the future of European defence, due by 19 March 2025. It says defence policy must stay in the hands of member states, with unanimous Council votes. It asks for more joint defence procurement, a "buy European" preference, less market fragmentation, support for small defence firms, and more spending on space, cyber, naval and artificial intelligence capabilities. It rejects joint European defence debt.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; this is Parliament's opinion ahead of the Commission's white paper.
- **Who it affects:** Member states, defence companies, banks and investors, and space and technology firms.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is due to publish the white paper by 19 March 2025.
